title: Lightly Steamed Saudi Arabian Tobiko Wrap
description: A quick and easy Saudi Arabian dish featuring tobiko, herbal flavors, and a glassy-jelly texture, all wrapped in a leaf and steamed to perfection, perfect for vegetarians
instructions: Rinse the spinach leaves and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a small bowl, mix together the agar agar, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the water to the bowl and stir until the agar agar is fully dissolved.
Bring the mixture to a boil in a small saucepan, then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the tobiko.
Lay a spinach leaf flat on a work surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the tobiko mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining spinach leaves and tobiko mixture.
Place the rolls in a steamer basket and steam over boiling water for 5 minutes.
Serve the rolls hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
